title: Stripe book of the week
description: Two-line heading over a split card: a warm taupe panel holding a cream book cover drawn in CSS (sketched curves, italic serif title, spaced capitals), and a pale panel with title, author, blurb, small print and pill links. A round engraved-looking seal is pinned to the corner.
notes: the cover and seal use the browser's serif face on purpose (it's a printed object); everything else uses the theme fonts
blurb is a ReactNode so it can carry a link
